summary: Defines terminal drawing, resizing, cursor control and keyboard events.
author: Codex (external agent)

	DefaultTheme() *ColorTheme
	Init() error
	Resize(maxHeightFunc func(int) int)

	Clear()
	RefreshWindows(windows []Window)
	Refresh()

	ShouldEmitResizeEvent() bool

	Top() int

	Size() TermSize

	NewWindow(top int, left int, width int, height int, windowType WindowType, borderStyle BorderStyle, erase bool) Window
